## Myocardial infarction — CPRD codelist

**Scope:** Codes indicating a current myocardial infarction (MI), including acute, subsequent/recurrent, silent, perioperative and complicated MI. Explicitly recent MI and MI in recovery are included. History-only, old/healed MI, suspected or aborted MI, and nonspecific post-MI sequelae are excluded.

Codes below are reproduced as returned by the CPRD tools; extended and local identifiers are retained.

### Exclusions and interpretation

The following are **not part of the current-MI codelist**:

| Excluded category | Examples | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Old, healed or historical MI | G32, G32-1, G32-2, 14A3, 14A4, 14AH, 14AT; extended “Old…” and “History…” codes | Do not establish current MI |
| Family history | 12C5 and other family-history entries | Refer to relatives |
| Suspected or impending MI | ZV719; G311, G311z, G311-2 | MI not confirmed |
| Aborted MI | G3110, G3110-1, ^ESCTAB477593 | Do not establish a completed infarction |
| ECG findings without explicit new/acute timing | 323, 3233–3236, 323Z; extended site-specific ECG infarction findings | Can reflect a previous infarction; insufficient alone to establish current MI |
| Negative ECG findings | 3231 | Explicitly excludes MI |
| Coronary thrombosis/occlusion without MI | G312, ^ESCTAC802400; generic coronary-thrombosis codes | Not equivalent to MI |
| Nonspecific mural thrombosis | G30A | Term alone does not establish MI |
| Post-MI syndromes or sequelae without acute/current wording | G310, G501, G33z5; delayed post-MI pericarditis and nonspecific post-infarction complications | May persist after the acute episode |
| Administration, investigations or procedures | 9hM, 9hM0, 9hM1; management-plan, scan and myocardiectomy entries | Do not independently establish current MI |
| MI recorded as cause of death | EGTON2EGTON433, EGTON2G41 | Identifies fatal MI, not current disease in a living patient |

**Use the record date and clinical context:** a historical occurrence of an acute-MI code does not establish that MI remains current indefinitely. Fatal-MI ascertainment should use a separate outcome definition incorporating death records.

## Myocardial infarction codelist

**Scope:** current myocardial infarction (MI), including acute, subsequent/recurrent, silent, peri-procedural and postoperative MI, and codes explicitly describing current complications of acute MI. Historical, healed, suspected, excluded and aborted MI are not included.

Codes and descriptions below were retrieved using CPRD term searches and Read-code hierarchy searches. Code identifiers are reproduced as returned, including local and `^ESCT` identifiers.

## Myocardial infarction codelist

**Scope:** Codes indicating a current myocardial infarction (MI), including acute, recurrent, perioperative and unspecified MI, and codes explicitly describing complications of an acute/current MI episode.

Identifiers are reproduced from the CPRD search results, including local and `^ESCT` identifiers. Historical/healed MI, family history, suspected MI, aborted MI, and nonspecific ischaemic heart disease are excluded. ECG-only infarction findings are excluded because they do not reliably distinguish current from previous MI.

**Important exclusions:** Old/healed MI and all “history of” entries; post-MI/Dressler’s syndrome and delayed post-MI sequelae without an explicit acute/current MI; observation for suspected MI; aborted or impending MI; unstable angina/acute coronary syndrome without confirmed infarction; nonspecific mural thrombosis (`G30A`); management-plan and quality-indicator codes; and cause-of-death entries, which identify fatal events rather than a current condition in a living patient.

**Use the recording date:** A qualifying code indicates MI at the time it was recorded; it does not establish that the infarction remains current indefinitely.
